rule_name: Reverse Channel Letters with Halo Illumination By Others Note Validation

view_matching_logic.Elevation: Validate Reverse Channel Letters with Halo Illumination note only in Elevation views where the Architectural drawing specifies REVERSE CHANNEL LETTERS W/ HALO ILLUMINATION BY OTHERS.

geometry_logic.boundary_detection: geometry_applicable = TRUE only when the detected view is an Elevation view. Geometry applicability is determined only from the view type and not from note text.
geometry_logic.expected_boundary_region: Wall signage region where reverse channel letters are shown.

required_entities: Reverse Channel Letters with Halo Illumination Callout Note
detected_text_variants: REVERSE CHANNEL LETTERS W/ HALO ILLUMINATION
REVERSE CHANNEL LETTERS WITH HALO ILLUMINATION
pass_condition: Architectural drawing contains REVERSE CHANNEL LETTERS W/ HALO ILLUMINATION BY OTHERS and the Submittal drawing contains REVERSE CHANNEL LETTERS W/ HALO ILLUMINATION or a valid equivalent.
fail_condition: Architectural drawing contains REVERSE CHANNEL LETTERS W/ HALO ILLUMINATION BY OTHERS but the Submittal drawing does not contain REVERSE CHANNEL LETTERS W/ HALO ILLUMINATION or a valid equivalent.
review_required_condition: Signage location is applicable but the note is partially readable.
Multiple nearby signage notes make the association ambiguous.
omit_condition: Architectural drawing does not contain REVERSE CHANNEL LETTERS W/ HALO ILLUMINATION BY OTHERS.
ARCH REF not found in the Submittal and Architectural drawing is unavailable.

reasoning.description: Explain whether the Architectural drawing specifies Reverse Channel Letters with Halo Illumination By Others and whether the corresponding note exists in the Submittal.

view_results.view_type: Detected actual view title from drawing

arch_trigger_variants: REVERSE CHANNEL LETTERS W/ HALO ILLUMINATION BY OTHERS
REVERSE CHANNEL LETTERS WITH HALO ILLUMINATION BY OTHERS
CHANNEL LETTERS W/ HALO ILLUMINATION BY OTHERS
CHANNEL LETTERS WITH HALO ILLUMINATION BY OTHERS
